params.body:
## Why

A cough while the voice is speaking cuts its answer off; the page then drops the noise transcript and the answer is never finished. The page also kept its own copy of the turn detection, separate from the bridge's.

## What changes

In `resources/views/mobile/voice.blade.php`:

- Turn detection comes from the bridge's `/session` answer (`turnDetection`), with the model's own replies off as before. Without it (an older bridge) the page uses plain semantic VAD as before.
- When a response ends cancelled because the model heard speech (`cutOff` from the bridge's `turn.mjs`) and the transcript that follows is noise, the page calls the lock's `resume()`: the voice is told to go on where it was, in a turn of its own. A real line from the owner clears that and is answered instead.

Depends on the portal-cli PR on branch `workbench/voice-noise-gate` (turn detection, noise reduction, `resume()`, `cutOff`), which has the evaluation checklist and the limits. Merge that one first; this page works with either bridge.

## Tests

`php vendor/bin/phpunit tests/Feature/MobileTest.php`: 21 pass. The page's inline script passes `node --check`.
params.title: Voice page: bridge's turn detection, finish answers a cough cut off
